limitations: No weighted or arbitrary graph generalization is proved.
Parity expansions do not establish monotonicity for every finite cycle length.
Earlier equivalent formulas in finite transportation or graph-flow geometry may exist.
Finite numerical tests do not replace the general proof.
scientific_integrity: The formulas are proved for simple connected unweighted cacti. Previously known decomposition, primal-volume, and cube-section facts are cited rather than claimed anew. Mathematical priority is provisional; there is no independent audit.
title: Exact Mahler products of cactus symmetric edge polytopes and a cycle-parity asymptotic
